modeling_note: Python fit uses binomial spline terms with group fixed effects and dyad-clustered GEE. Rscript/mgcv is not available in this environment.
equivalent_mgcv_formula: mgcv::bam(cbind(interaction_edges, non_interaction_edges) ~ s(log1p(weekly_centroid_distance_m), k=5) + s(dyad_weekly_ndvi_mean, k=4) + s(dyad_weekly_ndvi_abs_diff, k=4) + s(group_a, bs='re') + s(group_b, bs='re') + s(pair_key, bs='re'), family=binomial(), method='fREML', data=weekly_rows)
python_group_control_note: Python model collapses group_a/group_b levels with fewer than 5 weekly rows into side-specific other_group controls to reduce sparse fixed-effect instability.
